title: 花旗杨霭仪：腾讯AI变现路径清晰，元宝已创收，云业务可期
speaker: Alicia Yapp

segments.en: Is it clear to you, and it could be a longer term story, but is it clear to you that there will be fresh and new revenue streams coming through?
segments.zh: 您是否清楚，虽然可能是长期故事，但会有新的收入来源出现？

segments.en: Because of all the investments that, or is it, you know, people are going to be spending more time.
segments.zh: 因为所有这些投入，或者人们会花更多时间。

segments.en: When does their scale start to show up, basically, the AI story?
segments.zh: AI故事的规模效应何时开始显现？

segments.en: What buddy is already a new revenue stream that they don't have before?
segments.zh: 元宝已经是他们以前没有的新收入来源。

segments.en: This is actually able to charge based on the token.
And then I think the Xiaowei, the consumer AI, to be honest, I don't think there is a clear roadmap in terms of the actual new monetization.
segments.zh: 至于小微，消费者AI，说实话，我认为目前还没有清晰的变现路线图。

segments.en: But over time, I think when, because everybody is using WeChat every day, so it's going to be enhanced the existing monetization,
segments.zh: 但随着时间的推移，因为每个人每天都用微信，所以会增强现有的变现能力，

segments.en: which is either the gaming, the advertising, or the payment mechanism, like the transaction.
segments.zh: 包括游戏、广告或支付机制，如交易。

segments.en: So those will be the additions of the existing business.
segments.zh: 这些将是对现有业务的补充。

segments.en: And then, you know, they talk about into the future if they have access, compute power, they are thinking about also the renting GPU business, right?
segments.zh: 他们还提到，未来如果拥有算力，他们也在考虑GPU租赁业务。

segments.en: Which will through their cloud business, okay?
segments.zh: 这将通过他们的云业务实现。

segments.en: And then the model as a service, once their, let's say, Hunyuan 4 becomes good enough, strong enough model,
segments.zh: 然后模型即服务，一旦混元4足够强大，

segments.en: they could also strengthen their model as a service platform, which they could also generate revenue from there.
segments.zh: 他们就能加强模型即服务平台，并从中产生收入。
